system.name: RLinf
system.one_liner: a large-scale reinforcement learning system that realizes Macro-to-Micro Flow (M2Flow) transformation via a worker abstraction with flexible spatio-temporal scheduling

components.name: Procedural Programming Interface
components.role: user-facing interface for imperatively constructing RL workflows

components.name: Worker Group
components.role: set of RL components encapsulated as workers

components.name: Worker
components.role: encapsulates an RL component's main logic with communication and offloading functionality

components.name: Communicator
components.role: communication functionality allowing workers to freely communicate

components.name: Offloading
components.role: resource offloading mechanism enabling temporal multiplexing of hardware

components.name: Data Channel
components.role: adaptive communication utility supporting scalable worker interaction

components.name: Workflow
components.role: the procedural workflow describing data communication and interaction among RL components

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: core module producing a desirable micro execution flow via profiling-guided scheduling

components.name: Profiler
components.role: runtime profiling of worker characteristics

components.name: Policy
components.role: profiling-guided scheduling policy that searches for each worker's optimal execution mode

components.name: Controller
components.role: assigns workers to accelerators, manages connections, and orchestrates execution flow

components.name: Worker Dispatcher
components.role: dispatches function invocations to the corresponding workers

components.name: Exec Flow Manager
components.role: orchestrates the execution flow

components.name: Connection Manager
components.role: manages inter-worker connections

components.name: M2Flow Transformation & Scheduling
components.role: combines spatial and temporal scheduling to produce the micro execution flow

components.name: Spatial Scheduling
components.role: assigns workers to accelerators

components.name: Temporal Scheduling
components.role: determines workers' execution periods over time

components.name: Elastic Pipelining
components.role: mechanism enabling spatial orchestration of workers

components.name: Context Switch
components.role: mechanism enabling temporal orchestration of workers

components.name: Data Plane: Adaptive communication
components.role: point-to-point communication and data channel supporting scalable worker interactions

components.name: Launcher (Ray)
components.role: remotely launches and controls workers using Ray

content.key_idea: RLinf encapsulates RL components as workers, then uses a profiling-guided scheduler and controller to jointly schedule them in space and time (elastic pipelining and context switch), realizing the Macro-to-Micro Flow transformation over an adaptive-communication data plane launched via Ray.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom: user interacts with the Procedural Programming Interface, which produces a Worker Group and Workflow; these feed the Scheduler and Controller; their outputs drive M2Flow Transformation & Scheduling (spatial + temporal); underneath sit the Data Plane and the Ray Launcher.

summary: This figure shows the architecture of RLinf, a system for large-scale reinforcement learning built around a Macro-to-Micro Flow (M2Flow) transformation. Users imperatively construct RL workflows via a Procedural Programming Interface, which encapsulates RL components as Workers (each with a Communicator, Offloading mechanism, and Data Channel) grouped into a Worker Group, and produces a Workflow description. A Scheduler (Profiler + Policy) uses runtime profiling to search for each worker's optimal execution mode, feeding a Controller (Worker Dispatcher, Exec Flow Manager, Connection Manager) that assigns workers to accelerators and orchestrates execution. Together these drive the M2Flow Transformation & Scheduling module, which combines Spatial Scheduling (elastic pipelining) and Temporal Scheduling (context switch), sitting atop a Data Plane of adaptive communication and a Ray-based Launcher. The figure is a vertically layered, flat-colored box diagram (green for workers, blue for workflow, gray for sub-components) with hollow block arrows, and a dedicated bottom panel using colored square/diamond/triangle icons to depict worker scheduling across space and time.
summary_zh: 该图展示了 RLinf 的整体架构：用户通过过程式编程接口构建工作流，RL 组件被封装为 Worker（含通信、卸载、数据通道）；调度器基于性能剖析确定执行模式，控制器据此分配加速器并编排执行；两者共同驱动 M2Flow 的空间与时间调度（弹性流水线与上下文切换），底层为自适应通信数据面与基于 Ray 的启动器。
